symbols.∆: scoped change; one minimal delta per experiment

semantic_contract.rule: A symbol is a type label, never a claim. A semantic child inherits provenance, not truth.
semantic_contract.formula_status: TOKEN_VAZIO: the supplied symbolic expression is preserved as a notation seed only; no scientific, cosmological, legal or operational conclusion is inferred.

evolution_contract.baseline: route exists and was read back; route CI, independent review, provider enforcement, runtime and science are not promoted
evolution_contract.h1: each gap receives an owner, bounded experiment, falsifier, gate, privacy/legal constraint and rollback
evolution_contract.h0: more records without executable gates do not reduce risk
evolution_contract.acceptance_rule: advance only on exact evidence matching the predefined gate; otherwise remain TOKEN_VAZIO/NOT_RUN/UNVERIFIED
evolution_contract.rollback_rule: append a superseding record or revert by an authorized PR; never erase evidence

seven_directions.name: falsificação
seven_directions.question: o que faria a hipótese falhar?

seven_directions.name: segurança
seven_directions.question: como privacidade, legalidade e Zero Trust são preservados?
seven_directions.gate: least privilege, escopo, logs e ausência de segredo

gaps.gap: route artifact has no validator execution
gaps.risk: malformed topology may appear valid by prose
gaps.minimum_proof: validator receipt bound to branch, commit and blob
gaps.falsifier: missing edge, duplicate node, invalid state or broken reference
gaps.privacy_legal_zerotrust: public metadata only; no secrets; read-only token
gaps.rollback: remove only the unpromoted CI change by authorized PR

gaps.gap: no independent review bound to the two falsifiers and rollback
gaps.minimum_proof: review identity, scope, findings and disposition
gaps.falsifier: review finds unsupported claim or unsafe rollback
gaps.privacy_legal_zerotrust: minimum reviewer data; no private payload
gaps.rollback: keep branch unmerged; supersede review record if needed

gaps.gap: alphaXiv folder has no bound papers/claims
gaps.risk: bibliography may be mistaken for evidence
gaps.minimum_proof: paper id, exact claim, method, limitation and source passage
gaps.experiment: bind three papers only after topic selection
gaps.falsifier: passage does not support claim or method/limit is absent
gaps.privacy_legal_zerotrust: public papers only; respect access and attribution
gaps.rollback: remove membership or mark binding superseded; preserve notes
gaps.next_action: select three relevant papers; no claim promotion yet

gaps.risk: governance may exist only in documentation
gaps.minimum_proof: actual rules for target branch and bypass actors
gaps.falsifier: required checks absent or bypass wider than authorized
gaps.rollback: do not change provider settings without explicit authorization

gaps.minimum_proof: test notification or provider delivery receipt
gaps.experiment: send one controlled test to authorized channel
gaps.falsifier: no delivery, stale timestamp or missing receipt
gaps.privacy_legal_zerotrust: test payload contains no secrets or personal data
gaps.rollback: disable only the test route; preserve configuration receipt

gaps.minimum_proof: dry-run or controlled non-merge revert with before/after hashes
gaps.falsifier: cannot restore baseline or evidence is lost
gaps.privacy_legal_zerotrust: no device, install, deletion or production mutation

gaps.gap: retention, access and legal basis are not explicit per evidence class
gaps.risk: privacy, unlawful disclosure or unbounded retention
gaps.minimum_proof: data classification, purpose, access scope, retention and deletion authority
gaps.falsifier: secret, personal data or uncontrolled access appears
gaps.privacy_legal_zerotrust: deny by default; least privilege; no secrets in logs
gaps.rollback: quarantine unapproved field; do not delete evidence without authority

gaps.gap: current-branch post-merge Python/Six Sigma and physical gates are not all terminal
gaps.risk: PR-head PASS may be overgeneralized to merged/runtime/science domains
gaps.minimum_proof: terminal result bound to current commit for each domain
gaps.privacy_legal_zerotrust: read-only evidence; no device or signer access

gaps.gap: scientific/cosmological validation is outside the software route
gaps.risk: category error from code PASS to physical truth
gaps.minimum_proof: independent scientific protocol, data, uncertainty and falsifier
gaps.rollback: do not promote software evidence as science
gaps.next_action: keep isolated until qualified protocol exists
